items.text_th:
ส่งเมล์ไปแล้วเรื่องย้ายระบบโค้ดไม่ผ่าน แตไม่มีการตอบกลับ
ถ้าเราลอคอินสตรีมไว้ในคอมไอดีจะหลุดไหมครับ
items.text_vn: Mình đã gửi mail báo vụ chuyển hệ thống bị lỗi mã không qua, nhưng chưa ai trả lời. Nếu mình đã đăng nhập Steam trên máy tính thì ID có bị mất không ạ?
items.text_en: I already emailed about the account move because the code would not go through, but no reply yet. If I am logged in on Steam on my PC, will I lose my ID?
items.summary_vn: Gửi mail hỗ trợ vụ mã chuyển tài khoản lỗi nhưng chưa được trả lời, lo mất ID khi đang chơi bản Steam.
items.summary_en: Emailed support about a failed transfer code with no reply; worried about losing the ID while playing on Steam.

items.text_th: ถ้าปกติเล่นแต่ในสตรีมก็ไม่มีปัญหาอะไรครับ แค่เติมโค้ดบางโค้ดกับซื้อแพ๊คในเว็บของ vng ไม่ได้ครับ
items.text_vn: Nếu bình thường bạn chỉ chơi trên Steam thì không sao đâu, chỉ là không nhập được một số code và không mua được gói trên web của VNG thôi.
items.text_en: If you normally only play on Steam it is fine. You just cannot redeem some codes or buy packs on the VNG website.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời: chơi bản Steam vẫn ổn, chỉ không nhập được vài code và không mua gói trên web VNG.
items.summary_en: Answers: Steam is fine, you just cannot use some codes or buy packs on the VNG web shop.

items.text_th: เคยเข้าแล้วแล้วลบแอปเก่าไปแล้วทำไงคะ โดนแบบนี้งงเลย
items.text_vn: Mình từng vào được rồi, sau đó lỡ xoá app cũ mất thì giờ làm sao ạ? Bị như vầy mình rối luôn.
items.text_en: I had already logged in, then I deleted the old app. What do I do now? I am so confused by this.
items.summary_vn: Đã xoá app cũ sau khi chuyển, giờ gặp thông báo lạ (bị ban) và không biết xử lý thế nào.
items.summary_en: Deleted the old app after moving and now gets a confusing (ban) message; does not know what to do.

items.text_th: เราก็เป็นค่ะ ตอนนี้มันแบนนมั่วมาก ลองเช็คนะคะว่าไอดีที่เเบนใช่ของเรามั้ย ถ้าไม่ใช่ของเราแนะนำลบเเอพค่ะ แล้ววโหลดใหม่ เข้าได้ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Mình cũng bị vậy. Giờ ban lung tung lắm. Bạn thử xem ID bị ban có đúng là của mình không, nếu không phải thì xoá app rồi tải lại, vào được đó.
items.text_en: Same here. They are banning people randomly right now. Check whether the banned ID is really yours; if not, delete the app and download it again, then you can get in.
items.summary_vn: Than game ban lung tung; chỉ cách kiểm tra ID bị ban và tải lại app để vào được.
items.summary_en: Complains bans are random; suggests checking the banned ID and reinstalling to get back in.

items.text_th: ขอสอบถามคะในกล่องนี้มีอะไรบ้างคะ
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi trong hộp này có những gì vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Can I ask what is inside this box?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi bên trong hộp quay có những vật phẩm gì.
items.summary_en: Asks what items are inside a gacha box.

items.text_th: ยังไม่ได้กดซื้อเลยยยย
items.text_vn: Mình còn chưa bấm mua nữa nè.
items.text_en: I have not even bought it yet.
items.summary_vn: Nói mình cũng chưa mua hộp này.
items.summary_en: Says they have not bought the box yet either.

items.text_th: สอบถามครับผมจะย้ายจากglobal มาเล่น ผมกดรับโค้ดบัญชี แล้วให้ดาวโหลดตัวglobalมาแล้วมันขึ้นโหลดค้างต้องทำไงครับ ผมไม่ได้เล่นมานานมากแล้ว
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi, mình muốn chuyển từ Global sang chơi. Mình bấm nhận mã tài khoản, nó bảo tải bản Global về, tải xong thì bị đứng ở màn hình tải. Phải làm sao ạ? Lâu lắm rồi mình không chơi.
items.text_en: Question: I want to move from Global. I pressed "get account code", it told me to download the Global version, and now it is stuck on loading. What should I do? I have not played in a long time.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại muốn chuyển từ Global sang VNG nhưng bản Global bị đứng ở màn hình tải.
items.summary_en: A returning player trying to move from Global to VNG is stuck on the Global loading screen.

items.text_th:
ค้างยังไงค่ะ 
 ปรึกษาได้
items.text_vn: Đứng kiểu gì vậy ạ? Cứ hỏi mình nè.
items.text_en: Stuck how? You can ask me.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi lại tình trạng kẹt tải và đề nghị giúp.
items.summary_en: Asks how it is stuck and offers to help.

items.text_th: อิมูเลเตอร์เล่นได้ไม่โดนแบนใช่มั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Chơi bằng giả lập thì không bị ban đúng không ạ?
items.text_en: Playing on an emulator will not get me banned, right?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chơi bằng giả lập có bị ban không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether playing on an emulator gets you banned.

items.text_th: ยื่นเรื่องหลายรอบจนเล่นรหัสใหม่แล้วคับ 55555
items.text_vn: Gửi yêu cầu hỗ trợ bao nhiêu lần, giờ chơi luôn tài khoản mới rồi, haha.
items.text_en: I sent so many requests that I just started playing a new account, haha.
items.summary_vn: Gửi hỗ trợ chuyển tài khoản nhiều lần không được nên đã chơi tài khoản mới.
items.summary_en: Sent many transfer support requests with no result, so started a new account.

items.text_th: ดันเหรียญอีกแล้ว ไม่เคยสำเร็จ
items.text_vn: Lại đẩy xu nữa rồi, chưa bao giờ làm được.
items.text_en: Coin pushing again, I have never managed it.
items.summary_vn: Than sự kiện sắp tới lại có trò đẩy xu, chưa bao giờ thành công.
items.summary_en: Complains the upcoming event has coin pushing again; never succeeds at it.

items.text_th: เอาอีกแล้ว กิจดันเหรียญอีกแล้ว
items.text_vn: Lại nữa rồi, lại nhiệm vụ đẩy xu nữa.
items.text_en: Here we go again, another coin-pushing quest.
items.summary_vn: Ngán vì sự kiện mới lại có nhiệm vụ đẩy xu.
items.summary_en: Fed up that the new event has a coin-pushing quest again.

items.text_th: หึหึ อยากขอให้ขยายเพอร์บ้านมาก ไม่พอวางของสะสม555+
items.text_vn: Hì hì, rất muốn xin mở rộng giới hạn nội thất trong nhà, không đủ chỗ trưng đồ sưu tầm, haha.
items.text_en: Hehe, I really wish they would raise the house furniture limit, there is not enough room for my collectibles, haha.
items.summary_vn: Góp ý mở rộng giới hạn nội thất trong nhà vì không đủ chỗ trưng đồ sưu tầm.
items.summary_en: Suggests raising the house furniture limit because there is no room for collectibles.

items.text_th:
ไม่มีรถหรูให้ขับ แต่มี 3 ล้อพร้อมพาไปทุกที่
#playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.text_vn: Không có xe sang để lái, nhưng có xe 3 bánh sẵn sàng chở đi khắp nơi. #playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.text_en: No fancy car to drive, but I have a three-wheeler ready to take me anywhere. #playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.summary_vn: Dự sự kiện ảnh bằng ảnh nhân vật đi xe tuk tuk trong game.
items.summary_en: Joins the photo event with a picture of their character riding a tuk-tuk.

items.text_th:
สู่ท้องฟ้าอันไกลโพ้น
#playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.text_vn: Hướng tới bầu trời xa xăm. #playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.text_en: Towards the faraway sky. #playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.summary_vn: Đăng ảnh trong game dự sự kiện của group.
items.summary_en: Posts an in-game photo for the group event.

items.text_th:
รถตุ๊กตุ๊ก ❌
รถ (สามล้อบรรทุก) ม้า
#playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.text_vn: Xe tuk tuk ❌ — xe (ba bánh chở hàng) kéo bằng ngựa. #playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.text_en: Not a tuk-tuk ❌ — a (three-wheel cargo) cart pulled by a horse. #playtogether #playtogetherTH
items.summary_vn: Đăng ảnh vui: "xe tuk tuk" trong game thành xe ngựa ba bánh, dự sự kiện ảnh.
items.summary_en: Posts a funny photo for the event: the "tuk-tuk" is really a horse-drawn three-wheeler.

items.text_th: ฉันจะพาเธอลอย #playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.text_vn: Anh sẽ đưa em cùng thả trôi (Loy Krathong). #playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.text_en: I will take you floating (Loy Krathong). #playtogethervng #playtogetherTH
items.summary_vn: Đăng ảnh dịp Loy Krathong trong game dự sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Posts an in-game Loy Krathong photo for the event.

items.text_th: เล่นยังไงครับไม่เติมเลย
items.text_vn: Chơi kiểu gì vậy, không nạp đồng nào hả?
items.text_en: How do you play like that without topping up at all?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi bạn chơi sao mà có nhiều đồ không cần nạp tiền.
items.summary_en: Asks how they got so much without paying.

items.text_th: จำได้ว่าตอนชวนเพื่อนมาเล่นใหม่ๆ แล้วเพื่อนบอกว่าจะไม่เติม จะเล่นสายฟรี ปัจจุบันเติมทุกซีซั่น5555
items.text_vn: Nhớ hồi mới rủ bạn vào chơi, bạn bảo sẽ không nạp, chơi kiểu miễn phí thôi. Giờ thì mùa nào cũng nạp, haha.
items.text_en: I remember when I first invited my friend, they said they would never pay and play free. Now they top up every season, haha.
items.summary_vn: Kể bạn từng định chơi miễn phí nhưng giờ mùa nào cũng nạp.
items.summary_en: Jokes that a friend who planned to play free now tops up every season.

items.text_th: โห มีทุกพาสไหมครับ
items.text_vn: Wow, bạn có đủ mọi pass luôn hả?
items.text_en: Wow, do you have every pass?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có mua đủ mọi gói pass không.
items.summary_en: Asks if they own every pass.

items.text_th: เล่นเกมส์ฆ่าเวลา เล่นเอาเป็นเอาตาย
items.text_vn: Chơi game cho qua thời gian mà chơi như liều mạng.
items.text_en: Playing to kill time, but playing like your life depends on it.
items.summary_vn: Đùa rằng chơi giết thời gian mà nghiêm túc hết mức.
items.summary_en: Jokes about playing to kill time but going all-in.

items.text_th: ลองเปลี่ยนเน็ตหรือไวไฟอื่นก่อนครับ
items.text_vn: Thử đổi mạng di động hoặc wifi khác trước xem.
items.text_en: Try switching to mobile data or another Wi-Fi first.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ cách đổi mạng/wifi khi bản Global bị đứng lúc tải để chuyển tài khoản.
items.summary_en: Suggests switching network or Wi-Fi when the Global client is stuck loading during the transfer.
